say:1:1620576001:1.text: Hero! If you hadn't been here just now... I would've died for sure!
say:1:1620576001:1.source_cn: 英雄大人！刚才要不是你在……我肯定吓得哭出来了！
say:1:1620576001:1.male: Hero! If you hadn't been here just now... I would've died for sure!
say:1:1620576001:1.female: Hero! If you hadn't been here just now... I would've died for sure!

say:2:1620576002:1.text: You saved me again... Thank you! I won't forget it!
say:2:1620576002:1.source_cn: 你又救了我一次……谢谢你！我会记住的！
say:2:1620576002:1.male: You saved me again... Thank you! I won't forget it!
say:2:1620576002:1.female: You saved me again... Thank you! I won't forget it!

say:4:1620576003:1.text: Maybe to you... but to me, it was everything! I thought I was done for!
say:4:1620576003:1.source_cn: 对你来说是小事，对我可是大事！我、我差点就没命了呢！
say:4:1620576003:1.male: Maybe to you... but to me, it was everything! I thought I was done for!
say:4:1620576003:1.female: Maybe to you... but to me, it was everything! I thought I was done for!

say:5:1620576005:1.text: Let's keep moving. We're not out yet... but I'll stay right with you the whole way!
say:5:1620576005:1.source_cn: 我们继续走吧。出口还有一段路呢，我会紧紧跟好你的！
say:5:1620576005:1.male: Let's keep moving. We're not out yet... but I'll stay right with you the whole way!
say:5:1620576005:1.female: Let's keep moving. We're not out yet... but I'll stay right with you the whole way!

say:7:1620576004:1.text: I will! I promise I'll behave and stay right behind you this time!
say:7:1620576004:1.source_cn: 嗯！我会乖乖跟着你！这次绝对不会乱跑了！
say:7:1620576004:1.male: I will! I promise I'll behave and stay right behind you this time!
say:7:1620576004:1.female: I will! I promise I'll behave and stay right behind you this time!
